plugins.name: nextflow
plugins.description: Build, migrate, test, debug, and run Nextflow pipelines with Nextflow Platform, Wave, and nf-core.

plugins.name: nextflow-platform
plugins.description: Optional Nextflow Platform compute/credential setup, storage data links and seqerakit automation. Requires the enabled nextflow core plugin.

plugins.name: nextflow-nf-core
plugins.description: Optional nf-core analysis, GEO/SRA acquisition, template synchronization and pipeline maintenance. Requires the enabled nextflow core plugin.

plugins.name: nextflow-plugins
plugins.description: Optional Nextflow plugin development and legacy registry migration. Requires the enabled nextflow core plugin.

plugins.name: nextflow-provenance
plugins.description: Optional run/cache history analysis and lineage-store exploration. Requires the enabled nextflow core plugin.
